summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Synora dating app - Backend APIs (100% pass) and Frontend UI flows (all working). Tested: landing page, invite code flow, mock OTP authentication, discovery feed with opposite-gender matching, venue search, paths tab, chat list, profile tab with invisibility toggle, and sign out. Both male (Aarav) and female (Ananya) seeded users tested successfully.

issues: Tab labels show 'chat/index' and 'profile/index' instead of cleaner names like 'Chat' and 'Profile'

action_items: Consider renaming tab labels from 'chat/index' to 'Chat' and 'profile/index' to 'Profile' for better UX
critical_code_review_comments: Console warnings about expo-router layout children naming - 'No route named chat/profile exists' - these are cosmetic but could be cleaned up
useNativeDriver warning for animations - expected on web, not a bug
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded users from Supabase - 3 men (Aarav, Kabir, Dev) and 3 women (Ananya, Ira, Meher) in Bangalore
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows working: invite code → phone OTP → discover (existing user) or profile-setup (new user). Discovery correctly shows opposite-gender profiles. Venue search works (12 seeded venues). GPS activation will fail in browser sandbox - expected behavior. Mock OTP accepts any 6-digit code. Mock Razorpay shows 1.8s processing modal then completes.
